purpose: Freeze a finite seven-route prevalue review of issuer manufacturing execution, work-order and material conversion, lot and serial genealogy, in-process inspection, nonconformance, quarantine, rework, scrap, packaging and finished-goods release states before any source row, formula, direction, candidate value, comparator, security price or return is read.

adjacent_mentions_only: supplier procurement, logistics and supply-chain disruption
inventory production conversion, aging, obsolescence and custody
productive assets, capex, licenses, environmental effects and incidents
operating-scale, utilization, yield, defect and customer-quality KPIs
software, support and construction delivery lifecycles

requirements: lawful public or licensed point-in-time source with first-available, correction, supersession, process-rule, routing-version and quality-specification timestamps mapped to accepted trading sessions

stable issuer, listed-parent, privacy-safe plant, product family, BOM version, routing, work order, material lot, serial token, work center, operation, inspection lot, nonconformance, quarantine, rework, scrap, packaging and finished-goods release identities without current-state projection

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including planned, released, started, held, cancelled and completed work orders; issued, returned, consumed and substituted material lots; passed, failed, skipped, pending and repeated inspections; accepted, quarantined, reworked, scrapped, released, recalled and unresolved output

explicit missing, suppressed, corrected, reversed and genuine-zero semantics plus unit-of-measure, split, merge, substitution, genealogy and disposition conservation without filling uncovered issuers, plants, products, lots or operations with zero

no worker identity or biometric data, customer identity, plant security layout, production-control credential, OT or PLC configuration, proprietary recipe or exact process parameter, unreleased product design, source code, vulnerability or trade-secret detail

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a lawful deidentified event history linking input lots and serial tokens through split, merge, substitution, consumption, intermediate output, packaging, finished batch, release, withdrawal and recall while preserving unit conservation, correction clocks and every pending or unresolved state.

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign163, 165, 166, 178, 179 and 196 govern supplier, logistics, inventory, productive-asset, license, environmental and incident identities and clocks; none can be relabelled as a complete shop-floor work-order, material-genealogy and quality-release history.

Project milestones, software releases, tickets, recalls, claims and ledger balances cannot reconstruct plant operations, lot provenance, in-process inspection and physical disposition.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: plant_site_line_product_family_bom_routing_work_center_shift_machine_worker_lot_serial_inspection_type_direction_threshold_age_window_subset_weight_interaction_combination_or_model_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting a site, line, product family, BOM, routing, work center, shift, machine, worker cohort, lot, serial, inspection type, direction, threshold, age, window, subset, weight, interaction or model before complete lawful base histories are admitted would multiply hypotheses and exploit plant, product, lot, correction and issuer survivorship.

scientific_interpretation: Manufacturing work-order execution, material and lot genealogy, and inspection-to-disposition-to-release lifecycles are economically distinct from generic supply chain, inventory, capex, incident and operating KPI records, but distinction alone does not admit a factor. The absent complete lawful point-in-time privacy-safe manufacturing-execution and quality-history source is the binding gate.
next_action: Bind all seven routes and every Campaign212 infrastructure failure into one append-only ledger, publish terminal prevalue evidence, and authorize a genuinely different Campaign213 domain.
